description: Everything the adapter sends while migrate() runs, in order, captured from the real adapter (adapter construction included). `fresh` is an empty database; `current` one where every migration ran already. applied_at is the clock at migrate() time (fixed here).

fresh.sql: start transaction isolation level read committed
SELECT set_config('lock_timeout', $1, true)
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(1647206759, 1)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iam_schema_version (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), version INTEGER NOT NULL)
SELECT version FROM iam_schema_version WHERE id = 1
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iam_migrations (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at BIGINT NOT NULL)
SELECT name FROM iam_migrations

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iam_records (collection TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT COLLATE "C" NOT NULL, unique_key TEXT COLLATE "C", data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (collection, id), UNIQUE (collection, tenant_id, unique_key))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS iam_records_tenant ON iam_records (collection, tenant_id)
INSERT INTO iam_migrations (name, applied_at) VALUES ($1, $2)
SELECT collection, id, data FROM iam_records WHERE strpos(data, '\u0000') > 0 OR data ~* '\\ud[89a-f]'
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS iam_records_tenant_id ON iam_records (collection, tenant_id, id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS iam_records_unique_key ON iam_records (collection, unique_key, id) WHERE unique_key IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS iam_records_document ON iam_records USING gin ((data::jsonb) jsonb_path_ops)
INSERT INTO iam_migrations (name, applied_at) VALUES ($1, $2)

INSERT INTO iam_migrations (name, applied_at) VALUES ($1, $2)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS iam_records_expiry_expiresAt ON iam_records (collection, ((data::jsonb) -> 'expiresAt'), id) WHERE jsonb_typeof((data::jsonb) -> 'expiresAt') = 'number'

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS iam_records_expiry_failedAt ON iam_records (collection, ((data::jsonb) -> 'failedAt'), id) WHERE jsonb_typeof((data::jsonb) -> 'failedAt') = 'number'
INSERT INTO iam_migrations (name, applied_at) VALUES ($1, $2)
